title: Meta flags a Raebareli 18-year-old's Instagram suicide post at 8:58 pm; Uttar Pradesh Police reach him within 12 minutes after he took rat poison, and he is treated and stable
summary: 29 Mar 2026: Meta alert at 8:58 pm; Raebareli police reached an 18-year-old in 12 minutes after rat poison; hospital treatment, stable
account: On 29 March 2026 an 18-year-old class 12 student from the Mill Area police station limits of Raebareli, Uttar Pradesh, texted his girlfriend 'Alvida' and posted a suicide video on Instagram with rat poison and messages of intent after a breakup. At about 8:58 pm Meta flagged the content and emailed an alert to the Social Media Center at Uttar Pradesh Police headquarters, which traced his mobile number and location and alerted Raebareli police. A police team reached his home within 12 minutes and found him in severe distress with an empty rat-poison packet nearby; police and family took him to a nearby hospital, where he was treated, and on 1 April 2026 police said he was stable.
purpose: Meta's pipeline is built to find posts and live videos indicating suicide or self-injury risk, route them to trained reviewers and, in imminent cases, contact local authorities; the Uttar Pradesh Police Social Media Center exists to act on those alerts. This rescue is that purpose.
system: Meta's suicide and self-injury detection and review pipeline on Instagram, with email alerts to the Uttar Pradesh Police Social Media Center at DGP headquarters
deployer: Meta Platforms with the Uttar Pradesh Police Social Media Center (Decode: Uttar Pradesh has been part of Meta's suicide-prevention program since 2022)
taxonomy_note: A life-saving emergency intervention is not among the six types; chosen because the documented gain is routing a platform alert into a 12-minute police response.

ratings.reason: An 18-year-old who had taken rat poison was reached within 12 minutes of Meta's 8:58 pm alert, treated in hospital and reported stable; officials said even a slight delay could have been fatal. No clinician is quoted and the rodenticide is not identified, so the life-saving reading rests on the police account.

ai_role.statement: Police say Meta flagged the Instagram post at about 8:58 pm on 29 March and emailed the Uttar Pradesh Police Social Media Center; no source says whether Meta's classifier or a user report started the review, and Decode reports that UP alerts arise from 'artificial intelligence systems or user reports' reviewed by Meta staff. Everything after the email was human work: the center traced the phone number and location, Raebareli police reached the home in 12 minutes on the DGP's instructions, and a hospital treated him.
